_schema.description: Models to benchmark as lawyer agents. Infrastructure models (client, judges) listed separately.

infrastructure._recusal_note: When evaluating a lawyer model, exclude the judge from the same provider. For providers not in the panel (xAI, Moonshot, Alibaba, DeepSeek), all 3 judges score and take median.
infrastructure.aggregation: median for 3 judges, mean for 2 judges (after recusal)
